subtasks.description: Declare all parameters and localparams including FSM one‑hot state encoding (SIZE, IDLE, STOP_SEND, …), command constants (CMD24, CMD17, …), and compile‑time conditional definitions for READ_CYCLE, BD_EMPTY, and bd_cnt width based on RAM_MEM_WIDTH ( `ifdef RAM_MEM_WIDTH_32 / RAM_MEM_WIDTH_16 ).
constraints: Use `ifdef RAM_MEM_WIDTH_32 / RAM_MEM_WIDTH_16 to set READ_CYCLE, BD_EMPTY, and bd_cnt width; use scalar parameter/localparam declarations only.

subtasks.description: Declare all internal registers listed in S007 with their exact bit‑widths: state, next_state (9 bits), bd_cnt (width from B1), flags (send_done, rec_done, …), counters (resend_try_cnt, 3 bits), address/data registers (sys_adr 32, cmd_arg 32, cmd_set 16), edge‑detect helpers, CIDAT, Dat_Int_Status (8 bits).
constraints: bd_cnt width must match the conditional width defined in B1 (2 or 3 bits).
All registers must be scalar `reg` types; no unpacked arrays or multi‑dimensional references.

subtasks.description: Combinational logic block that computes next_state from current state and relevant inputs/registers exactly as specified in the transition table of S011 (IDLE checks free_tx_bd/free_rx_bd, GET_TX_BD uses bd_cnt and tx_full, etc.).
constraints: Only compute next_state; no output assignments or register updates.
Use one‑hot state constants from B1; block must be combinational ( always_comb ).

subtasks.description: Single sequential always_ff block with asynchronous reset: on reset set state <= IDLE and clear all registers; on posedge clk update state <= next_state, and update flags, counters, address/cmd registers, resend counter, Dat_Int_Status, CIDAT, and edge‑detect transm_complete according to the per‑state rules in FSM_OUT (S015) using handshake signals.
constraints: All register updates must be inside one always_ff block; avoid generate/genvar.

For BD word loading, unroll explicitly with if-else cases on bd_cnt values (0/1 for 32‑bit, 0..3 for 16‑bit) and assign halves of registers using concatenation/mask operations; do not use unpacked arrays or multi‑dimensional references.

subtasks.description: Combinational block that drives output ports re_s_tx, re_s_rx, we_req, d_write, d_read, start_tx_fifo, start_rx_fifo, ack_transfer, a_cmp_tx, a_cmp_rx based on state, tx_cycle, rx_cycle, and handshake conditions, and passes through registered values for cmd_arg, cmd_set, sys_adr, Dat_Int_Status, CIDAT.
constraints: Use continuous assignments or always_comb; do not infer sequential logic.
Drive outputs directly from state/register values; no generate blocks or unpacked array assignments.
